# EnsureSpace

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Starts a new page unless at least `MinHeight` of body height remains on the current one.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `PaginationWrapperBase`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new EnsureSpace()
new EnsureSpace(float minHeight)
new EnsureSpace(float minHeight, IElement child)
```

## Properties

- [`MinHeight`](#minheight): The body height, in points, that must remain on the current page for the child to start here.

### `MinHeight`

```csharp
float MinHeight { get; set; }
```

The body height, in points, that must remain on the current page for the child to start here. Use `Units` for other units: `Units.Mm(50)`.
